ns2:course.label: Additive Manufacturing and Product Design
ns2:course.description: Additive manufacturing fundamentals, how and why to design products using additive manufacturing, theory, and practice of product innovation, modern product design. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 371 or consent of instructor. Senior or graduate standing, or instructor permission.
